name: learning-machine/kapitalbank-checkout
description: Framework-agnostic PHP client for the Kapital Bank / Birbank Checkout API (OAuth2 token, payments, refunds, webhooks) with an optional Laravel service provider.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Used automatically as the PSR-18 client / PSR-17 factory when none is passed
suggest.php-http/discovery: Finds any installed PSR-18 client / PSR-17 factory when Guzzle is absent
suggest.illuminate/http: Laravel: LaravelHttpClient sends through the Http facade (Http::fake() works)
